parameters.name: NameSpaceShortId
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. The region ID is not included. We recommend that you use this parameter.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. The format is `Region ID:Namespace name`. This parameter is retained for backward compatibility. If you specify this parameter, `NameSpaceShortId` is ignored. We recommend that you use `NameSpaceShortId` to simplify the request.
